trigger: Before the march: Kit arrives with an Army sled (if trust.kit>=5 and kit_alive).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Minus forty. The column is forming in the street: blankets, sleds, kids on shoulders. A snowmobile engine, then Kit.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Wrench! I stole the Army a present. From the Army. It's a cargo sled. Don't ask about the guy who had it.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: I owe you like three. This is one. I'm coming too. Somebody has to steal stuff on the way.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Ew. Feelings. Okay. Let's go before I cry from the cold.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: I would NEVER. ...From the column. Okay. Rules. Let's go.
